agenda.2026-11-01-opep-production-decemb: OPEC+ decides how much oil to pump in December

The seven countries steering output (Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria, Oman) meet every month; in October they kept their quotas unchanged for November [1][2]. If they open or close the tap, the price of a barrel, and so of petrol, moves.
agenda.2026-11-03-midterms-etats-unis.wh: All 435 seats in the House of Representatives, 35 Senate seats and 39 governorships are up for grabs [1][2]. If Congress changes hands, the president will find it harder to pass his laws, budgets and tariffs.
agenda.2026-11-05-banque-angleterre-taux: The Bank of England sets its rate
Decision at noon London time, with a new Monetary Policy Report [1][2]. A higher rate makes loans dearer for British households and firms and often lifts the pound.
agenda.2026-11-09-cop31-antalya.title: COP31: the world climate conference opens in Turkey
agenda.2026-11-09-cop31-antalya.why: Two weeks of talks in Antalya, with a leaders' summit on 11 and 12 November; Turkey hosts, Australia leads the negotiations [1][2]. On the table: money for poorer countries, moving away from fossil fuels and carbon markets.
agenda.2026-11-17-nvidia-resultats.title: Nvidia reports its results
agenda.2026-11-17-nvidia-resultats.why: The maker of AI chips presents the quarter that ended on 25 October, at 11 pm Paris time [1][2]. Its numbers often move the whole US stock market, because Nvidia weighs very heavily in the main indices.
agenda.2026-11-17-budget-2027-vote.title: 2027 budget: National Assembly vote
agenda.2026-11-17-budget-2027-vote.why: After debating revenue and then spending, French MPs are due to vote on the whole state and social security budget at first reading [1]; the text must pass before 31 December, otherwise a special law is needed [1][2].
agenda.2026-11-18-apec-shenzhen.title: APEC summit in Shenzhen
agenda.2026-11-18-apec-shenzhen.why: Leaders of the 21 Asia-Pacific economies, including the United States and China, meet in the home city of China's tech giants [1][2]. A meeting between the US and Chinese leaders there could revive or freeze the trade war.
agenda.2026-11-29-opep-reunion-semestrie: The year-end OPEC+ meeting sets the broad lines of next year's production [1]. It sets the tone for oil prices over the winter.
agenda.2026-12-09-fed-taux.title: The Fed sets its rate, with its forecasts for 2027
agenda.2026-12-09-fed-taux.why: Last meeting of the year for the US central bank, with its forecasts and the "dot plot" where each official shows where they see rates heading [1][2]. The dollar, loans and stock markets worldwide depend on it.
agenda.2026-12-14-g20-miami.title: G20 summit in Miami
agenda.2026-12-14-g20-miami.why: The twenty largest economies meet at the Doral golf resort, owned by the US president [1][2]. Trade, poor countries' debt and the war in Ukraine are expected to dominate.
agenda.2026-12-17-bce-taux.title: The ECB sets its rate for the euro area
agenda.2026-12-17-bce-taux.why: Last decision of the year by the European Central Bank, with new growth and inflation forecasts [1][2]. It sets the cost of mortgages and the return on savings in euro countries.
agenda.2026-11-17-budget-2027-vote.verif: Date given by a single specialist site; the budget timetable has already slipped once.
agenda.2026-11-29-opep-reunion-semestrie: Date announced in August by a single source; not yet confirmed by OPEC.
